STEP 1 - Scene: This is a snack-style plate with a whole red apple, two granola bar pieces (one bar packet, such as Nature Valley Oats & Honey), and two chicken wing pieces (a drumette and a flat).

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white dinner plate with wide rings, about 27 cm across. Area = 3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Whole apple
- 2 crunchy granola bars
- 1 fried chicken drumette
- 1 fried chicken flat

STEP 4 - Area (food covers about 22% of the plate):
| Item | % of plate | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Apple | ~9% | ~51 cm² |
| Granola bars | ~8% | ~46 cm² |
| Drumette | ~3% | ~17 cm² |
| Flat | ~2.5% | ~14 cm² |

STEP 5 - Volume:
- **Apple:** treated as a sphere about 7.5 cm wide, which gives about 220 ml. (Area × height would overestimate.)
- **Granola bars:** 46 × 1.0 cm = 46 ml.
- **Drumette:** 17 × 2.5 cm = 42 ml.
- **Flat:** 14 × 2 cm = 28 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams:
- **Apple:** 220 ml × 0.85 ≈ 185 g.
- **Granola bars:** 46 ml × 0.5 ≈ 23 g. A Nature Valley bar pack is about 42 g, but the pieces look thin, so I set this to about 35 g.
- **Drumette:** 42 ml × 0.7 (bone) ≈ 30 g, minus some for the bone, so about 25 g edible.
- **Flat:** 28 ml × 0.7 ≈ 20 g.

STEP 7 - Energy:
| Item | Calculation | kcal |
|---|---|---|
| Apple | 185 g × 52 kcal/100 g | 96 |
| Granola bars | 35 g × 470 kcal/100 g | 165 |
| Drumette | 25 g × 290 kcal/100 g | 73 |
| Flat | 20 g × 290 kcal/100 g | 58 |

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The total is about 265 g and about 390 kcal, which is plausible for a snack plate.
